description: Bone mineral density falls at a steady monthly rate in microgravity. Daily resistive exercise slows that rate, up to a ceiling.
limits: The base rate is NASA's figure for weight-bearing bones without countermeasures. How much exercise slows it is our assumption. Diet, medication, the bone site and individual differences are left out.

description: Muscle strength falls at a steady monthly rate in microgravity. Daily resistive exercise slows that rate, up to a ceiling.
limits: NASA reports that muscles weaken in microgravity but this page gives no rate, so every number here is an assumption. Muscle group, diet and individual differences are left out.

description: Aerobic fitness falls at a steady monthly rate without exercise. Daily exercise slows that rate, up to a ceiling.
limits: Every number here is an assumption. Aerobic exercise, fluid shifts and individual differences are left out.

description: Sleep debt is the sleep you missed over the last 7 days: for each night, the hours below your sleep need.
limits: The sleep need is an assumed value, the same for everyone. Sleep quality, light exposure, shift changes and workload are left out.

description: Mission dose is the sum of every daily dose since launch.
limits: This is arithmetic on the dosimeter readings. It has no status bands because we have not verified a dose limit from a source yet. Solar particle events are not forecast.
